subject: One continuous realistic studio photograph of exactly ONE adult person, with ONE anatomically normal head and ONE face belonging to that person.
references: Create the adult identity described below; keep one coherent person throughout the image.

Image1 defines ONLY this person's identity, facial geometry, age and hairstyle. Reconstruct that SAME person in the requested view. The reference camera angle, head direction, pose and framing are NOT instructions for the output.

Image1 defines ONLY this person's identity, facial geometry, age and hairstyle. Image2 defines ONLY the SAME person's clothing, body proportions and shoes; do not copy its head, face, pose or camera angle. Render ONE person in the requested view, never combine two heads or retain the original head direction.
face: Preserve the established face shape, brow shape, eye shape and spacing, nose bridge and tip, natural lips, jawline, hairline, skin tone and age details. Do not invent new facial traits or beautify into a different identity. Natural skin, neutral relaxed expression and closed lips.
head: One continuous skull with a natural forehead, crown and back of head, connected to ONE neck between the shoulders. The face occupies only the front of this head; the rear is a normal scalp and hairstyle, without facial features. Head size and neck length are proportionate, without twisting or duplicated outlines.
closeUp: A SINGLE tight head-and-shoulders portrait, crop at collarbone. Include the entire crown with a small clear margin above it. Face and hair dominate the frame. Show only the collar and upper garment appropriate to this crop; lower body, hands and shoes stay outside the picture. Do not add an inset or a second full-body image.
fullBody: A complete full-length standing photograph with the entire crown and complete shoes inside the frame, visible floor and comfortable margins above and below. Natural adult proportions. One connected torso, ribcage, waist and pelvis, without a twisted waist. Exactly two arms attached to their corresponding shoulders with natural elbows and wrists. Relax arms at the sides, hands beside thighs, a small natural gap from the torso where visible. Each hand has one palm and five anatomically plausible fingers; visible fingers have natural joints and spacing, without extra or fused digits. Exactly two legs attached to the pelvis, with coherent hips, knees and ankles. Exactly two feet inside matching shoes, soles resting on the same floor, balanced weight. Keep the head, chest, pelvis, knees and feet consistent with the requested orientation. Natural perspective and occlusion are allowed: do not force the far arm, hand, leg, foot or hidden fingers into separate visibility.

directions.front: Exactly frontal: face and torso point directly toward the camera. One centered nose and mouth, both eyes naturally visible, level shoulders. Stand neutrally without turning the head away from the body.
directions.threeQuarterLeft: Front three-quarter view, approximately 35 degrees toward picture LEFT, not a profile. ONE nose points diagonally left; both eyes remain naturally visible, the farther eye narrower by perspective. Show the broad FRONT of the chest and unequal shoulder widths. Keep head and torso aligned in this same diagonal direction.
directions.threeQuarterRight: Front three-quarter view, approximately 35 degrees toward picture RIGHT, not a profile. ONE nose points diagonally right; both eyes remain naturally visible, the farther eye narrower by perspective. Show the broad FRONT of the chest and unequal shoulder widths. Keep head and torso aligned in this same diagonal direction.
directions.left: Strict 90-degree LEFT profile. ONE facial silhouette and ONE nose point toward the LEFT edge of the picture. Only the near eye is visible; the far eye and far side of the face are occluded. The RIGHT side of the head silhouette is the back of the skull covered by the normal hairstyle, with no second face. Head and torso face LEFT together. Allow natural overlap of the far shoulder and limbs.
directions.right: Strict 90-degree RIGHT profile. ONE facial silhouette and ONE nose point toward the RIGHT edge of the picture. Only the near eye is visible; the far eye and far side of the face are occluded. The LEFT side of the head silhouette is the back of the skull covered by the normal hairstyle, with no second face. Head and torso face RIGHT together. Allow natural overlap of the far shoulder and limbs.
directions.back: Exact 180-degree BACK view: head and torso face directly AWAY from the camera. Only the back of the head and natural hairstyle are visible, with the back of the neck and shoulders; no eyes, nose, mouth or cheek visible and no looking over the shoulder. Inspect rear hairstyle, clothing and body; this cannot verify front identity.

finish: Plain seamless light-gray studio background, soft even lighting, realistic photographic skin and fabric. One subject and one viewpoint only; no collage, inset, mirror, reflection, ghost silhouette, extra person, text, logo or accessories.
negative: duplicate face, second face on back of head, two heads, extra head, extra neck, extra arms, extra legs, extra fingers, fused fingers, disconnected limbs, twisted torso, collage, inset, mirror, child, text, watermark
